desc: A version is 1 to 4 parts separated by dots, each part one or more decimal digits (leading zeros allowed: "01" means 1). If a is not a valid version return "bad version: " followed by a; otherwise if b is not valid return "bad version: " followed by b. Compare the versions part by part from the left as numbers, treating missing parts as 0 (so "1.0" equals "1"). Return -1 if a is lower, 1 if a is higher, 0 if they are equal.

decls.ts: type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
